claim: In the second quarter of 2024, Microsoft reported $62.0B of revenue.
summary: Calendar 2024Q2 (2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30) revenue was $64,727,000,000 (E1), not $62.0B. The $62.02B figure corresponds to fiscal FY2024Q2 (2023-10-01 to 2023-12-31) (E2), which the claim mislabels as Q2 2024.
